limits: No model inference or training was executed during this audit.
Model weight files and tokenizer binaries were not reread; checkpoint identity is cross-checked between source-bound training, capacity, freeze and TEST_INPUT records.
The external standard-library JAR was not reread; its registered identity is retained.
The existence of one recorded test per arm is established for the audited directories; unlogged processes elsewhere are not forensically excluded.
Separate post-test train-fit diagnostics are excluded from all final-case counts and acceptance decisions.
No post-test model, wrapper, or threshold reselection is authorized by this audit.
